# Leonardo.Ai

> > Leonardo.Ai is an AI-powered image generation platform offering both a web application and API for creating visual content.

Leonardo.Ai provides developers and creators with tools to generate images using artificial intelligence. The platform supports API integration with authentication, webhooks, and credit-based usage for programmatic image generation.

## Key Topics

- Leonardo.Ai
- API authentication
- Image generation
- API key setup
- API credits
- Webhooks
- cURL
- Leonardo web app
- Getting started
- Quick start
